statements.impact_statement: OpenSSH host key handling use-after-free. The restic image carries the ssh client binaries (openssh-client-common, openssh-client-default and openssh-keygen 10.3_p1-r0) in its Alpine layer. Nothing that runs the image starts ssh: restic runs it for an sftp: repository (observed), and all nine workloads (the database, OpenBao and etcd backup CronJobs, the two restore tests, the dump load test, the backup verifier and the two audit-sink shippers) build their repository URL with a fixed `s3:` prefix (in the script, or in the ExternalSecret template for the shippers); none of their scripts calls ssh, sftp, scp or ssh-keygen.

statements.impact_statement: OpenSSH password authentication bypass, exploitable through sshd's password check on musl; the client packages carry no password check. The kustomize-controller v1.10.1 image of the Flux copy pushed to CAPI children (apps/base/cluster-api-clusters/flux-gotk) carries only the OpenSSH client packages (openssh-client-common, openssh-client-default, openssh-keygen 10.3_p1-r1): no openssh-server, no sshd binary, no sshd_config, no host key, no PAM, no account with a password hash. The entrypoint is tini then kustomize-controller, the pod listens on 8080 (metrics) and 9440 (health) only, and every GitRepository in this repository uses an https:// URL.

statements.impact_statement: OpenSSH password authentication bypass, exploitable through sshd's password check on musl; the client packages carry no password check. The scan of forgejo 15.0.11-rootless lists only the OpenSSH client packages (openssh-client-common, openssh-client-default, openssh-keygen 10.2_p1-r0); Trivy matches every binary package built from the openssh source, so no openssh-server is installed. The forge runs with DISABLE_SSH and START_SSH_SERVER false (git over HTTPS only, port 3000; Forgejo's own SSH server is not OpenSSH anyway), and the two lock-cleaner containers run a shell loop that calls no ssh.
